correction.what: Line 1: the space inside the compound is removed (तपः स्वाध्यायनिरतं → तपःस्वाध्यायनिरतं). No letter is changed.
correction.evidence: तपःस्वाध्यायनिरत is one compound; the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit analyses tapaḥ-svādhyāya-niratam as compound members, and Critical Edition 1.1.1 has the same words. The metre is not affected (anuṣṭubh, 32 syllables, before and after).

correction.what: Line 1: श्रीमाञ्छ्त्रुनिबर्हणः → श्रीमाञ्छत्रुनिबर्हणः (a stray virāma after छ is removed).
correction.evidence: Metre: the Wikisource verse has 31 syllables and fails the śloka check; corrected, it has 32 and passes as anuṣṭubh. Critical Edition 1.1.9 reads śrīmāñ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ, the same word (with ś not assimilated to ch).

correction.what: Line 1: सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञो स्मृतिमान् → सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञः स्मृतिमान् (ओ → ः; a final ओ before स् is not possible sandhi).
correction.evidence: Sandhi: before स् a final -aḥ stays visarga (or becomes स्), never ओ. Critical Edition 1.1.14 has the same word (sarvaśāstrārthatattvajña smṛtimān, with the visarga lost before s-). Metre unaffected (anuṣṭubh, 32 syllables).

correction.what: Line 1: शृङ्गवीरपुरे → शृङ्गवेरपुरे (वी → वे). The alternative spelling शृङ्गिबेरपुरे, the commonest in this Wikisource text, is noted.
correction.evidence: The town is शृङ्गवेरपुर / शृङ्गिबेरपुर; शृङ्गवीरपुर is not found elsewhere. Critical Edition 1.1.25 reads śṛṅgaverapure. Metre unaffected (anuṣṭubh, 32 syllables).

correction.what: Line 2: दण्डकारण्यवासीनाम् → दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम् (long ī → short i).
correction.evidence: Metre: with the long ī the fourth pāda breaks the śloka cadence (syllables 5–7 short–long–short); corrected, the verse passes as anuṣṭubh. Grammar: the genitive plural of -वासिन् is -वासिनाम्. The Critical Edition has no counterpart of this verse, so there is no Critical Edition evidence.

correction.what: Line 1: प्रेक्ष्य चास्ति महाबलः → प्रेक्ष्य चास्थि महाबलः (ति → थि).
correction.evidence: अस्थि (the bones of Dundubhi) is the object of प्रेक्ष्य and of चिक्षेप; अस्ति (the verb) leaves the sentence without its object. The Critical Edition (1.1.51) lacks this line, so the evidence is sense and grammar. Metre unaffected (anuṣṭubh, 32 syllables).
देवत is not a regular a-stem (देवता is feminine); दैवत is. Critical Edition 1.1.68 reads pūjitaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ. Metre unaffected (anuṣṭubh, 32 syllables).

correction.what: Line 2: त् क्षत्रियो भूमिपतित्वमीयात् → स्यात् क्षत्रियो भूमिपतित्वमीयात् (the lost first syllable स्या is restored).
correction.evidence: Metre: the Wikisource line has 10 syllables for 11 and the verse (43 syllables) matches no metre; corrected, it has 44 and passes as upajāti. Critical Edition 1.1.79 reads syāt kṣatriyo bhūmipatitvam īyāt.
